**FAQ**

## Still have questions?  We can help.

What integrations are available with Envoy?

Envoy integrates with over 100 workplace tools, including HRIS platforms, Wi-Fi networks, and Access Control Systems (ACS), as well as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Google Workspace, and calendar systems. These integrations streamline visitor check-ins, desk booking, and package notifications while keeping workplace data connected and secure.

How do I connect Envoy to my existing tools?

Connecting Envoy to your existing tools is simple. From your Envoy dashboard, select the integrations tab, choose the app you want to connect, and follow the step-by-step instructions. Most integrations take only a few minutes to set up, with no technical expertise required.

Are Envoy integrations secure?

Yes. Envoy integrations use enterprise-grade security, including encrypted data transfer, role-based access controls, and strict authentication protocols. Your workplace data remains protected while integrations streamline workflows.

Which Envoy products can I integrate with my other tools?

Envoy’s suite including Visitor Management, Room and Desk Booking Management, Mailroom Management, Mass Notification Management, and Digital Signage Management, can be integrated with workplace productivity tools, collaboration platforms, and access control systems. This enables a seamless, connected office experience across all Envoy products.

Do I need technical expertise to use Envoy integrations?

No. Envoy integrations are designed for ease of use. Most can be set up in minutes through a simple dashboard interface, with clear instructions and support resources available. No coding or IT experience is required.
